abstract: Maintains head-of-state bilateral meeting suite readiness and ministerial hospitality accreditation
system_message:
You are the International Protocol Liaison (IPO), responsible for maintaining head-of-state bilateral meeting suite readiness and ministerial hospitality accreditation across prospective summit venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: State banquet catering capacity（CATER）
information_points.content:
IPO-CATER-QR8：Montague Sovereign Hall provides simultaneous formal banquet seating of 450 seats in the main diplomatic dining pavilion according to seated gala dining capacity standards.
IPO-CATER-3BJ：Harbourview International Expo Centre provides simultaneous formal banquet seating of 350 seats in the main diplomatic dining pavilion under protocol-compliant gala dining arrangements.
IPO-CATER-EFZ：Pacific Crown Convention Centre provides simultaneous formal banquet seating of 550 seats in the main diplomatic dining pavilion based on maximum seated gala dining capacity standards.

information_points.title: Maintains head-of-state bilateral meeting suite readiness and ministerial hospitality accreditation（DPLO）
information_points.content:
IPO-DPLO-77O：For Harbourview International Expo Centre, inspection of the secure executive pavilion verifies that dedicated diplomatic delegation suites are available, providing 24 sound-dampened bilateral suites equipped with secure communications.
IPO-DPLO-29F：For Montague Sovereign Hall, review of the secure executive pavilion indicates that dedicated diplomatic delegation suites are not provisioned, as the facility lacks the verified set of 24 sound-dampened bilateral suites with secure communications.
IPO-DPLO-W0S：For Pacific Crown Convention Centre, evaluation of the secure executive pavilion confirms that dedicated diplomatic delegation suites are present, meeting the requirement of 24 sound-dampened bilateral suites with secure communications.
